title: Of Speedy Relief and the Light of Dawn
summary: Concluding his ten days of philosophical defense, Bakhtiyar addressed King Azadbakht:
keywords: of the speedy relief of allah
full_text:
Concluding his ten days of philosophical defense, Bakhtiyar addressed King Azadbakht:

'Sire, the darkest hour of the night is always the hour that immediately precedes the dawn. When a man feels that all earthly avenues are blocked, when the walls close in and despair knocks at the portal, that is the very moment when the relief of providence arrives with lightning speed!

Deliverance does not require an army of horsemen; it enters through a whisper of truth, an unexpected witness, or the turning of a lock.

He who perseveres in honor, keeping his conscience clean to the final breath, will find that the scaffold of persecution becomes the throne of vindication, even as the history of the innocent prisoner demonstrates before the eyes of all generations.'
moral: When human difficulties reach their absolute limit, divine relief arrives with miraculous swiftness.
